19.0.0.intro: A quiet download-progress pill for updates, safer end points, and a round of timeline polish.

highlights.title: Update progress
highlights.text: While an update downloads, a small pill in the top bar shows how far along it is.

highlights.title: Out point past the end
highlights.text: If you set an out point beyond the end of the video, it stops at the end with one dim line. An in point past the end is refused.

highlights.title: Start fresh
highlights.text: No folders are made in Downloads until a clip is saved, and the prompt asks only once per session.

changes.title: Window strip
changes.text: The start and crash screens can be dragged by a strip along the top edge.

changes.title: Timeline
changes.text: Zoom keeps its centre and follows the pointer. Both ends of a range move together, and clip names show on the bars.

changes.title: Sign-in
changes.text: A rejected sign-in now shows in its own row, and private videos are told apart from members-only ones.

changes.title: Offline
changes.text: After repeated offline failures, Copy details is offered so you can send a report.

changes.title: Updating
changes.text: Restart to update waits until the clip you are making is done.

changes.title: Clip count and length
changes.text: Each clip made with the Clip button counts once, and a clip longer than 24 hours is refused.

18.0.0.intro: Clearer clip failures, a space check before each clip, and Final Cut timelines that follow your look.

highlights.title: Checks before it fails
highlights.text: Clipr checks the folder has room and can be written to before a clip starts, and says plainly if it can't.

highlights.title: Timeline size for Final Cut
highlights.text: Pick vertical 9:16, same as the video, or from your look, under Your look in Settings.

highlights.title: Copy your clip list
highlights.text: Copy as text or save a .txt from the Export and History menus.

changes.title: Clip length per campaign
changes.text: An optional row in campaign settings, with a plain verdict in the export bar.

changes.title: Audio lane per language
changes.text: Each ticked audio language gets its own lane, and YouTube's control bar is hidden in the preview.

changes.title: Start fresh
changes.text: After updating from an older version, a one-time prompt offers a fresh start. Your data is backed up first.

changes.title: Failure rows
changes.text: Rows now say when a folder can't be written, a drive is missing, or a video is age-restricted or members-only.

changes.title: After a crash
changes.text: A note says so, with a dismiss button, and clears when the next clip finishes.

changes.title: Send report
changes.text: Reports go through the live report service, and the page confirms what was sent.

changes.title: Waiting for the transcript
changes.text: The transcript lane and tab show a quiet waiting state instead of looking empty.

changes.title: Timeline
changes.text: A rounded timeline card with the tools row on top and the export bar fixed at the bottom.

changes.title: Frame rate
changes.text: Changing the timeline kind no longer resets the frame rate to 30.

changes.title: Fit
changes.text: Fit keeps the ruler centred.

17.0.0.intro: Timeline fixes, and no empty folder made at launch.

changes.title: Short timelines
changes.text: A short timeline scrolls its tracks under a sticky ruler.

changes.title: Cleaner launch
changes.text: Clipr no longer creates its data folder until it has something to save.

changes.title: Select range key
changes.text: Select range is now D, keeping S free for skipping in review.

16.0.0.intro: A title bar that doubles as the top bar, new timeline tools, and a clear reason for every failure.

highlights.title: Timeline tools
highlights.text: Select range, zoom and pinch, a pointer that scrubs, and scissors that drag a range.

highlights.title: Top bar is the title bar
highlights.text: On Mac and Windows the top bar now doubles as the window's title bar.

highlights.title: Failures say why
highlights.text: Removed video, bot check, rate limit, format gone and missing tools each get their own sentence.

changes.title: Undo for the Clip button
changes.text: Undo now restores a moment made with the Clip button, and each clip keeps its own row name.

changes.title: Crash fallback page
changes.text: A second crash within a minute shows a simple page with Reopen, Send report and Copy details.

changes.title: Retry keeps your range
changes.text: A failed cut keeps its range. Retry re-cuts it, and Save for later banks it.

changes.title: Final Cut
changes.text: A picked look always applies, and an unreadable old look no longer blocks the move.

changes.title: Settings safety
changes.text: If the settings file is gone or empty, Clipr restores the kept copy and says so.

changes.title: Help and tips
changes.text: Tips on or off is shared by every video, and Help search covers transcript, speed, quota and zoom.

changes.title: Zoom cap
changes.text: View menu Zoom In now obeys the zoom cap.

changes.title: Left panels
changes.text: Back returns to the video you were on, and failed links are not saved.

15.0.0.intro: Clearer help, Final Cut layouts, and failures that tell you why.

highlights.title: Help that walks you through it
highlights.text: Answers come as numbered steps, and Show me in Clipr points at the real buttons.

highlights.title: Final Cut layouts
highlights.text: Choose how each campaign lands in Final Cut: one Export event, an event per video, per day, or flat.

highlights.title: Clear failures
highlights.text: A failed clip says why, with Retry and Change folder on the same row.

changes.title: Open in your editor
changes.text: Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve and CapCut open with the saved clip from the Clip menu.

changes.title: Import moments
changes.text: Add several moments at once from a list or a sheet.

changes.title: First-use tips
changes.text: Short pointers on first use, which you can replay from Help.

changes.title: Sign-in at launch
changes.text: Clipr checks your YouTube sign-in when it opens, so 1080p is ready when you are.

changes.title: Clip names
changes.text: Names come from the words in the range, and the name is the file's name.

changes.title: Undo
changes.text: Undo takes back every language of a clip you just made.

changes.title: Space on buttons
changes.text: Space now presses the button you are on.

changes.title: Speed control
changes.text: Speed no longer sits over Back 5.

changes.title: Two-word clip names
changes.text: Clip names are two words, and the name is checked before a project name is suggested.
